item.title: Teghaza 001: Sahara Meteorite Unlocks Mars’ Ancient Water
item.description: A 2‑lb Sahara meteorite, Teghaza 001, dates back 4.1 billion years and preserves Mars’ early water‑rock interactions, reshaping our view of the Red Planet.
